The Dynamic Martin DYN-6006-03 FS is a 1–2 person full spectrum near zero EMF infrared sauna designed for buyers who want the most advanced infrared technology in the smallest possible footprint. At just 39" wide and 250 lbs, it ships in a single box and plugs into a standard 120V/15 AMP outlet — making it the most accessible entry point into full spectrum near zero EMF therapy in the Dynamic lineup.

Full spectrum means your body receives all three infrared wavelengths in every session. FAR infrared has the longest wavelength and does most of the heating. MID infrared reaches muscles and joints, supporting circulation and reducing pain. NEAR infrared is the shortest of the three wavelengths and is absorbed closest to the skin. Most saunas at this price point and footprint deliver FAR infrared only — the Martin delivers all three through a 6-heater system combining 4 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR infrared carbon panels and 2 Near infrared elements, with EMF output under 3 MG at 2–3 inches from the heating elements.

The Martin is purpose-built for solo wellness routines. Whether you place it in a master bedroom, apartment, condo, basement, walk-in closet, or home gym, the compact 39" × 36" exterior fits where larger saunas simply cannot. It operates on any standard 120V/15 AMP outlet on a dedicated breaker — no electrician, no hardwiring, no construction. Bring it in, clasp together the panels, plug it in, and your full spectrum sauna is ready to use the same day it arrives.

Every session is enhanced by the interior chromotherapy color lighting system with Red Light Therapy, which adds therapeutic light wavelengths to your infrared session simultaneously. The interior LED control panel handles temperature, timer, and lighting adjustments simply and directly. Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary audio with a built-in speaker keeps your playlist or meditation audio running throughout. The clear tempered glass door and roof vent keep the cabin feeling open and well-ventilated, and the natural Canadian Hemlock construction maintains the warm, clean aesthetic that ages well in any interior setting.

The ideal temperature range is 118°F–132°F, with a maximum of 140°F — comfortable, breathable temperatures that allow longer sessions compared to traditional high-heat saunas. Because the Martin is designed for 1–2 people, it heats up quickly and efficiently, making short daily sessions genuinely practical rather than something you need to plan around.

Dynamic Saunas is produced by Golden Designs, Inc., a California-based company focused exclusively on home infrared sauna wellness. The full spectrum FS line uses PureTech™ heating technology — a proprietary carbon panel design engineered for near zero EMF output alongside dedicated near infrared elements. The 5-year limited warranty covers wood, structure, heating elements, and electronics.
